name: codepen-theme-original
description: A CodePen-inspired dark color theme for Visual Studio Code. Language grammars are provided by VS Code and recommended language extensions.

scripts.check: npm run check:theme && npm run check:compatibility && npm run check:docs && npm run check:visual && npm run check:release
scripts.lint: node --check src/colors.js && node --check src/theme.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check scripts/lib/compatibility.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/providers.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/vscode-runtime.mjs && node --check scripts/capture-vscode-screenshots.mjs && node --check scripts/vscode-screenshot-runner.cjs && node --check scripts/check-provider-drift.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-theme.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-compatibility.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-readme.mjs && node --check scripts/render-visual-baseline.mjs && node --check scripts/tokenize-providers.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-provider-matrix.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-vscode-versions.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-release.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-vsix.mjs
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build && npm run check
scripts.deploy: npm run check:release && npm run check:package && vsce publish --packagePath ./build/codepen-theme-original.vsix
